_doc.about: session-archive settings. Created by session-archive on its first run; plugin updates never touch this file. Every key is null, which means "use the built-in default" (shown in its note), so this file behaves exactly like having none and follows the defaults of later versions. Replace a null to change that setting. Flags win over environment variables (SESSION_ARCHIVE_DIR, SESSION_ARCHIVE_PROJECTS), which win over this file. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Paths may start with ~; a relative path is taken from the archive folder (out_dir and projects_dir: from the folder the command runs in).
_doc.projects_dir: Claude Code transcripts folder. Default: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects, else ~/.claude/projects.
_doc.min_turns: Sessions with fewer user turns are skipped as trivial. Default: 10.
_doc.min_kb: Sessions smaller than this many KB are skipped as trivial. Default: 50.
_doc.live_minutes: A transcript written in the last N minutes is live (usually this session) and waits. Default: 2.
_doc.exclude: Project folder names to skip: a plain entry matches anywhere, "^x" matches names starting with x. Default: ["^-private-tmp-", "^-tmp-", "scratchpad"].
_doc.state_dir: Run history, lock and last-run.json. Default: <archive>/.state.
_doc.skipped_file: Sessions skipped on purpose (JSON lines). Default: <state_dir>/skipped.jsonl.
_doc.skipped_hash_chars: Hex characters of the transcript sha256 to record. Default: 64.
_doc.index_file: One line per pair. "" = no index. Default: "INDEX.md".
_doc.index_header: Written once when the index file is created. "" = nothing. Default: "# Archived Claude Code sessions\n\n".
_doc.index_heading: Template written before each run's index lines. "" = none. Default: "".
_doc.index_line: Template for each pair's index line. Default: "- {date} [{base}]({base}.digest.md) - {project} - {user_turns} user turns{continuation_note}".
_doc.index_continuation_note: What {continuation_note} becomes for a continuation pair. Default: " (continuation)".
_doc.log_file: One entry per run. "" = no log. Default: "log.md".
_doc.log_position: "end" appends; "top" puts the newest entry first, under the # title line. Default: "end".
_doc.log_heading: Template for each run's log heading. Default: "## [{now}] archived {count} pair(s)".
_doc.log_item: Template for each pair under the log heading. Default: "- {base}".
_doc.pre_command: Runs before run archives anything (a string goes through the shell; a list runs as is). Non-zero exit stops the run. Default: none.
_doc.post_command: Runs after run, with the result in its environment. Default: none.
_doc.digest: Digest labels (string, list of accepted labels, or null inside labels to leave a field out), field order, field_prefix, session_format ({id}), range_separator, none, headings, speakers, speaker_inline. Keys you leave out keep their defaults. The README has the details.
